title: On a generating function of the basis of weakly holomorphic functions on an elliptic curve
summary: Let $\Gz$ be a cofinite Fuchsian group whose quotient $\Gz\backslash\HH$ has genus one and a single cusp, normalized to be at $\infty$ with width one. Let $\Xg$ be its smooth compactification, which is an elliptic curve over $\CC$. Let $x,y$ be canonical generators of the function field on $\Xg$, which have poles of order $2,3$ respectively at the cusp and which {satisfy} a generalized Weierstrass relation $y^2+(a_1x+a_3)y=x^3+a_2x^2+a_4x+a_6$.
